## Activity

River Outreach recorded 70 captures during April 2019. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists managed in line with the expected arrangements. The service reported no operational disruption beyond routine leave, and sessions continued to be delivered across the reporting period. Overall activity provides a clear record of imaging undertaken at the site during the month.

## Image quality

There were 11 ungradable captures, giving an ungradable rate of 15.7. This result identifies a requirement for continued attention to image acquisition and review processes. Staff should maintain the established checks during sessions and use feedback from image review to support consistent capture quality. The available information indicates that image quality remained suitable for most of the recorded activity.

## Grading

Four captures were graded as referable, recorded as 4 in the reporting data. The median lag for grading was 6. This indicates that grading was completed within the expected operational workflow, while the referable results should continue through the appropriate follow-up arrangements. The findings from April 2019 should be considered alongside routine monitoring of activity, image quality, and grading performance at River Outreach.
